headline: Google.org Awards USD 2.5M Grant to Helium Health for AI Maternal Care in Nigeria
summary: Google.org awarded Nigerian health tech startup Helium Health a USD 2.5 million grant to deploy artificial intelligence aimed at reducing maternal deaths among 1.9 million pregnant women.
why: Philanthropic grants from major technology corporations support the scaling of health-tech innovations and AI applications in developing markets.
